## LTX-2.3 Prompting Tips

1. **Core Actions**: Describe events and actions as they occur over time  
2. **Visual Details**: Describe all visual details you want to appear in the video  
3. **Audio**: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene

## Report LTX-2.3 Issues
To report any issues when running this workflow, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues)

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

A lone explorer stands on a rocky cliff above a frozen arctic lake while a powerful aurora borealis dances across the sky. The aurora is extremely active and constantly moving, large flowing ribbons of green, cyan, purple and pink light pulse rhythmically across the entire sky. Waves of light ripple from horizon to horizon like luminous curtains, expanding, twisting, folding, and reforming in continuous motion. Bright energy pulses travel along the aurora bands, causing sections to intensify and fade in glowing waves.

The camera slowly pushes forward toward the explorer while slightly tilting upward, emphasizing the sky. The aurora grows brighter and spreads, shimmering and cascading across the stars with dramatic movement.

The environment reacts to the light:
aurora colors flicker across the frozen lake surface, reflections ripple and distort as ice shifts slowly. Thin mist flows across the water, snow particles drift in the wind, and small chunks of ice gently rotate in the lake.

The explorer’s jacket and backpack straps flutter in the cold wind, hair and clothing subtly moving. Breath vapor appears in the cold air.

Stars twinkle and occasionally streak faintly. The aurora continues to surge and pulse with energetic motion throughout the scene.

cinematic photoreal nature documentary style, dramatic night lighting, atmospheric depth, strong environmental animation, epic aurora activity, continuous movement.
